acceptance: `evolve inbox consume <item> --resolution X` leaves the item in consumed/ with the stamp (red today)
fix: Add `--resolution <text>` (and `--cycle`, default console) to `evolve inbox consume`; it writes consumed{at (UTC), via: console-manual, cycle, resolution} in the same operation as the move.
summary: Console consumptions carry a `consumed` object ({at, via, cycle, resolution}) on the moved item. `evolve inbox consume <item-path>` moves the item and acks its fingerprint but writes no stamp, so the operator edits the moved JSON by hand after the CLI, which is outside the interface.
title: `evolve inbox consume` cannot record the consumed stamp every console consumption carries
